content.stem: 某银行人力资源部的一位招聘经理已将一名候选人列入私人银行部门客户经理职位的最终候选名单。该银行的合规政策规定，招聘团队必须对新员工进行适当的背景调查，以保护银行免受欺诈和洗钱等潜在风险。在识别入围候选人的潜在负面信息时，哪些资源最有用？（请选择三项。）

options.C: 互联网和公共媒体搜索

content.stem_en: A recruitment manager in the human resources department of a bank has shortlisted a candidate for the position of relationship manager in its private banking division. The compliance policy of the bank stipulates that proper background checks on new employees must be completed by the recruiting team to protect the bank against potential risks, including fraud and money laundering. Which resources would be most useful for identifying any potential negative information regarding the shortlisted candidate? (Select three.)

options_en.E: Personal recommendation letters from close colleagues
